messages:
Taylor: quick FYI  an internal link in the runtime samples guide is 404ing from the quickstart flow. the snippet link /samples/runtime/kv-cache.md -> '#eviction-behavior' doesn't land.
Ben: thanks, which environment? staging or prod?
Taylor: noticed it on staging when running through the quickstart smoke. the header was reworded in the samples patch last week.
Docs-bot: docs-scan: detected broken fragment /samples/runtime/kv-cache.md#eviction-behavior (staging). filed DOCS-3210.
Yara: that rename was in PR 4321 where we made the heading "eviction semantics". likely we forgot to add an anchor alias.
Taylor: quick plan: add an explicit HTML anchor above the heading and update any TOC references. I'll open a tiny PR and add a one-line changelog frontmatter so release notes capture the fix.
Ben: ping me for review and include a preview assertion that the fragment exists. also add a test that the quickstart flow follows the link (so onboarding smoke won't regress).
Taylor: opened PR: https://git.internal.redwood.io/docs/pr/9733  diff is tiny. commands I ran locally:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/kv-anchor-alias
echo "<!-- anchor: eviction-behavior -->" | cat - content/samples/runtime/kv-cache.md > tmp && mv tmp content/samples/runtime/kv-cache.md
git commit -am "docs(samples): preserve eviction-behavior anchor for quickstart links"
git push origin fix/kv-anchor-alias
```
Yara: nice. tiny nit: include "changelog: restore sample anchor" in frontmatter so it's visible in the docs release digest.
Taylor: added changelog line and a Cypress preview that visits the TOC link and asserts location.hash. bumped for review.
Ben: quick skim  looks safe. Nikhil?
Nikhil: CI flaked on the preview run (intermittent net timeout). retriggered CI. please squash the WIP commit.
Taylor: squashed and updated PR description. CI passed on rerun.
Docs-bot: PR 9733 merged to main by Nikhil. staging preview rebuilt. DOCS-3210 marked resolved.
Taylor: verified on staging: link resolves and quickstart smoke follows the fragment. closing the ticket. thanks for the quick turnarounds! :sparkles:
